name: Lila Reselli
source:
[i]"I chose this path of my own volition."[/i]

[i]Compassionate Idealist[/i]

A young woman born and raised in Noah. After a chance meeting with 50Y-O-61, she hears a strange voice, sees someone's memories, and feels an indescribable emotion. To find the answer to all of these, she resolves to become a Sylphid.

[From [url=https://products.voltage.co.jp/recordnoah/english/characters/?page=lila]Voltage Inc.[/url]]
